brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single cell piece:0,0,0;full with cover top and bottom (cover:0,0,0;full;top and bottom) forms closed 80mm tall hex volume; 5 side openings sealed with hex-port-plug, 1 with louvre – no open faces remain except filtered vent.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: port:0#0,0#0 = hex-port-louvre in slot 0 provides weather-louvred ventilation; other 5 ports plugged to keep enclosure closed while allowing airflow through louvre.

finish.summary: Built a single-cell closed enclosure: full hex base with solid top and bottom covers. One side port is a louvre (hex-port-louvre) for breathing; the other five side ports are plugged (hex-port-plug) to keep the enclosure closed. Mesh clash clear.
